note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 4.2 ("The Hold Time MUST be either zero or at least three seconds."). Positive: TestRFC4271OpenHoldTimeOnWire inspects flushed sendOpen wire bytes for default (90s), configured 0s, and configured 3s; TestOpenValidateHoldTime verifies ValidateHoldTime accepts 0, 3, 90, 180, and 65535. Negative: TestOpenValidateHoldTime verifies ValidateHoldTime (called from session_handlers.go) rejects 1 and 2 with NOTIFICATION 2/6 (OPEN Message Error / Unacceptable Hold Time).
